facts: The university records fair-faced concrete and double-curved thin shells built without posts or beams. Overall scale is approximately 20 m high and 30 m wide.

record: Tunghai University chapel history and design
facts: The church uses four curved surfaces and the roof surfaces each have two straight and two curved edges.

record: Tunghai University collection, measurements of the four roof pieces
facts: Irregular hexagonal base, higher altar roof at 19.20 m and lower nave roof at 17.15 m. Church is oriented toward the east.
